_note: PAT-234. Scenario 19's seven patients and proportion measure (IP = adults, Denom = 50+, Numer = 65+; p1 72M, p2 69M, p3 67F, p4 62F, p5 57F, p6 42M, p7 32F) with three supplemental data elements built the way the eCQM workspace's SDE tab builds them: the standard `SDE Sex` (Patient.gender), a value-kind risk adjustment factor `RAF Age Band` (age bands 18-49 / 50-64 / 65+) and a boolean risk adjustment factor `RAF Elderly` (the numerator's AgeRange >= 65 tree). Locks: (1) the workspace's SDE elements reach the published MeasureDefinition by usage (they used to be dropped at publish, so neither the evaluation nor the exchange package knew the measure had any); (2) the evaluation reports each element as a value → patient-count distribution — `SDE Sex` used to contribute nothing at all because strings were dropped by the count-only aggregation; (3) a FHIR primitive counts as its value (`female`, not `FHIR.AdministrativeGender`); (4) a boolean element distributes as true / false; (5) patients without a value are counted separately (none here).
